title: Careers per type family
caption:
Not every career fits every type, and that's good news.

The four Mizaj type families tend to thrive in very different work: thinkers in systems and strategy, the heart-led in people and words, guardians in structure and service, makers in building, designing and doing. These are starting points, not limits.

Save this for the next time a relative asks 'aage kya karna hai?'

Which family are you, and does your job match?
